title: Radio
description: Native radio marked with a filled dot, echoing how the charts mark a chosen point

props.name: label
props.description: Radio: visible label wrapping the native input.

props.name: name
props.description: Radio: native group name. Share it within a group and keep it distinct from other groups on the page.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Radio: classes on the outer label. className and ref target the input.

props.name: orientation
props.description: RadioGroup only: layout and aria-orientation; defaults to vertical. Supply the group accessible name through native ARIA props.
